rule: Domain rule from the user, not a measurement: a house on a Ha Noi street front has at least 3 floors. calibrate_heights.py apply, after calibration, Wikidata and sibling rows: a row listed below whose height_src is then g25cal or est gets height = max(height, 3 x 3.3 m) and floors = max(floors, 3); height_src frontrow where the height or the floors change. osm / osm_part / wikidata / sibling rows are never touched.
frontrow_definition: footprint area within area_m2; a street centre line within half-width + setback_m of the outline (nearest distance); streets = major_classes at any name, named_classes with a name not starting with alley_name_prefixes (case-insensitive; unnamed ones are alleys); not_streets excluded; half-width = max(half_width_default_m, lanes x lane_width_m / 2 when tagged), clamped to half_width_clamp_m; the shortest segment from the outline to that centre line crosses no other footprint by more than cross_tolerance_m. Built by buildings/frontrow_heights.py build from the raw layer and osm_roads.parquet.

params.not_streets: bridge, tunnel, covered, indoor or area tagged (anything but no / empty)

ids_encoding: per file: sorted building ids as deltas (first value is the id itself)
